name: postgresql_ssl_compression_active
title: Postgresql SSL compression active
description: Database allows connections with SSL compression enabled. This may add significant jitter in replication delay. Replicas should turn off SSL compression via `sslcompression=0` in `recovery.conf`.

source.upstream_description: Database allows connections with SSL compression enabled. This may add significant jitter in replication delay. Replicas should turn off SSL compression via `sslcompression=0` in `recovery.conf`.

notes: pg_stat_ssl_compression is not a default postgres_exporter metric and is only available on PostgreSQL 9.5-13 (removed in PG 14). See https://github.com/samber/awesome-prometheus-alerts/issues/289#issuecomment-1164842737
